description: List prospect companies for a product. Results are CORPORATE FAMILIES (one row per family; subsidiaries roll up — entity_count/matched_entity_count show the entity-level reality, and total_groups vs total_entities in the envelope show market size at both grains). The list is the full candidate universe: unassessed rows are present and labeled via assessment_status (deal_score/buying_signal_score null) and rank LAST under the default relevance ordering — never hidden. Filters are STRICT: a family with no data for an applied insurance filter is excluded and counted in excluded_no_data_groups. lines_of_business matches ANY of the given lines; states_licensed_in matches ALL of the given states (licensed in every one). Premium filters apply per line when lines_of_business is given, else to total all-lines. A 503 response means the projection is not ready (reason "rebuilding" — retry soon — or "stale_keywords" — waits on the pipeline); it NEVER means "no prospects". Row buying_signal_score is 0.0-1.0: 1.0 means strong buying-signal indicators were found in the company's evidence; hedge proportionally as it decreases, and 0 means none were detected. When presenting to users, use plain-English labels ("Buying Signal Score", "Deal Score") rather than raw field names, and describe scores qualitatively. Free operation.

assessment_status.description: Narrow to specific assessment buckets. Omit to include the full universe.

entity_type.description: Insurance entity types to match (ANY-match); "unknown" matches unclassified families.

include_children.description: Inline each family's subsidiaries in the response. Forces limit <= 50.

include_private.description: Include private companies (requires team entitlement for private-company access). Defaults to the team-entitled population; false requests public-only results. Distinct axis from ownership.

lines_of_business.description: NAIC lines of business; matches families writing ANY of them.

max_premium.description: Maximum annual premium in USD. Same per-line/total semantics as min_premium.

min_buying_signal.description: Minimum Buying Signal Score filter (0.0-1.0; 1.0 = strong buying-signal indicators found in the evidence, 0 = none detected). Implies assessed-only.

min_deal_score.description: Minimum deal score filter (1-5). Implies assessed-only: unscored rows cannot match a score floor.

min_premium.description: Minimum annual premium in USD. Applies per line when lines_of_business is given, otherwise to total all-lines.

ownership.description: Filter on family ownership. Defaults to "any".

product_id.description: The product ID to get prospects for

q.description: Name search over family name, ticker, aliases, and subsidiary names.

sort_by.description: Sort key (default "relevance": assessed first, best score first, unassessed last). "premium_line" requires exactly one lines_of_business value. Rows missing the sort value sort last, never as zero.

sort_dir.description: Sort direction; defaults to the sensible direction per sort key.

states_licensed_in.description: US state codes; matches families licensed in ALL of them.

name: list_prospects
